# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-colors

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

WCAG contrast audit + CVD simulation + curated palette + Tailwind config emitter.

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** A colour being chosen or judged — any colour, in any context.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "what colour should this be", "does this pass contrast", "is this colour-blind safe", « quelle couleur pour ce fond »

## When it is not

Not this one when: the markup has structural defects rather than a colour question (sprezzature-accessibility), or the colours belong to a chart being drawn (sprezzature-figures). The exhaustive trigger catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.
